snippet.title: The Devil Card — Official Trailer
snippet.description:
The Devil Card is an indie card battle game inspired by Final Fantasy VIII’s Triple Triad. Select 5 cards and place them on the Grid. Flip opponent cards to win, collect them, and progress through the story. Defeat the Devil to earn his soul card and complete the campaign, or play with custom rules in Freeplay mode.

Wishlist The Devil Card on Steam ⇒ store.steampowered.com/app/3968080/The_Devil_Card/
